# Test Invoice Fixtures

Place sample PDF invoice files here for use in E2E tests.

## Recommended Test Files

- `test-invoice.pdf` - Basic invoice in SEK
- `invoice-eur.pdf` - Invoice in EUR (for currency testing)
- `invoice-usd.pdf` - Invoice in USD (for currency testing)

These files should be actual PDF invoices that can be used to test:
- PDF upload functionality
- Invoice extraction
- Currency handling
- File storage
